The desktop app keeps JDownloader out of sight and opens its window at once, torrents can go to a debrid service only when it has them cached and be seeded afterwards, and the Android app shows the other versions. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## ✨ Added

- **Only cached torrents to a debrid service, if you like.** With "Send only cached torrents to the debrid service" on under Settings > Torrents, KnightLoader asks the service first. A torrent it has not cached goes on to the next service or the built-in torrent client. TorBox and Premiumize.me can answer; Real-Debrid, AllDebrid and Debrid-Link cannot, so with the switch on they get no torrents. ([#59](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/59))
- **Seeding what a debrid service fetched.** "Seed what the debrid service fetched" hands a finished torrent to the built-in client, which seeds it under your seeding targets without downloading anything. Every file is checked first, and for a `.torrent` file every piece. ([#59](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/59))
- **The other versions in the Android app.** Its settings have the Apps cards of the web interface: the desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, Docker with a button that copies the `docker run` command, the source code, and the browser extension.
- **The privacy policy in the Android app**, linked from the About card.
- **Unraid in the Android app and the README**, dimmed until KnightLoader is listed in Community Applications.

## ⚡ Improved

- **A torrent taken up again to seed never downloads.** A finished torrent with a file missing or cut short stops seeding and says why on its row.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The desktop app's JDownloader stays out of sight.** It opened its own window and update dialogs because it was not started headless. ([#58](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/58))
- **The desktop app's window opens at once.** JDownloader starts in the background and joins when it is ready, instead of holding the window back for minutes on the first start. ([#58](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/58))
- **No console windows on Windows** from Java, yt-dlp, ffmpeg or the programs set to run on events.
- **Closing the desktop app stops its JDownloader.**
- **A torrent starts even with a single seeder.** The torrent library could stay at 0 bytes next to a connected seeder; it is updated to the version that fixes this.
- **A torrent added to a debrid service at shutdown is still cleaned up.** Its job on the service was not saved and stayed on the account.
- **In the Android app:** a single file is "1 file", one instance found offers "Add this instance", an instance that comes back reads Connected again, and the About text says that the QR scanner from Google sends Google usage diagnostics.

## 🌐 Translations

- The new texts in all 42 languages, in the web interface and the app.
